strings: Despite how full m_c's nest has gotten, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} just can't seem to get rid of any of the trinkets {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'ve/'s} collected.
m_c is always hoarding objects, to the point that other cats are noticing.
r_c asks m_c why {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} can't seem to throw away any of the items they don't use, and m_c defensively snaps that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} might need them in the future.
After one too many clanmates came to r_c concerned about m_c's hoarding habit, r_c diagnosed {PRONOUN/m_c/object} with hoarding disorder.
